options.title: Gas is {fact1} of a gas station's sales. So what does it make on it? ⛽
options.first_line: Gas is {fact1} of everything a gas station sells. So how much does it make on your tank?
options.first_frame: Night forecourt: Rohan squeezes the pump handle into his car, the pump's big price display spinning, a glowing GAS STATION canopy sign overhead and a giant tag on the pump reading {fact1} OF SALES.

options.title: Your tank is part of {fact1} of a gas station's sales. What does it keep? ⛽
options.first_line: Rohan fills his tank at a gas station. Gas is {fact1} of what it sells, so how much of his money does it keep?
options.first_frame: Close on the pump nozzle clicking off in Rohan's car, the pump screen counting up, the station's GAS sign and its little shop glowing behind him.

options.title: Card companies took {fact4} from gas stations. So who makes money on your gas? ⛽
options.first_line: Every time you pay at the pump, the card company takes a cut. So does the gas station make anything on your gas?
options.first_frame: A card tapping the reader on a gas pump, a coin flying off the card into a bank-card logo, the canopy sign GAS STATION above and the pump price spinning.

why: It names something every viewer pays for and asks how much the station makes on your tank without giving it away, while C's title already hints the twist (card companies take the money) and B's first line spends its first second on a name.
